ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is $20\text{cm}$, $BC=6\text{cm}$. Circle $O$ is the inscribed circle of $\triangle ABC$. The tangent line $MN$ of circle $O$ intersects $AB$ and $CA$ at points $M$ and $N$, respectively. What is the perimeter of $\triangle AMN$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that circle O is the inscribed circle of $\triangle ABC$, and the tangent of circle O, MN, intersects AB and AC at points M and N, respectively,

$\therefore$BF=BE, CF=CD, DN=NG, EM=GM, AD=AE,

$\because$ the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is 20cm, and BC=6cm,

$\therefore$AE=AD=$\frac{AB+AC-BC}{2}$=$\frac{20-BC-BC}{2}$=$\frac{20-12}{2}$=4(cm),

$\therefore$ the perimeter of $\triangle AMN$ is AM+MG+NG+AN=AM+ME+AN+ND=AE+AD=4+4=\boxed{8}(cm).

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is $20\text{cm}$, and $BC=6\text{cm}$. Circle $O$ is the incircle of $\triangle ABC$. The tangent line $MN$ of circle $O$ intersects $AB$ and $CA$ at points $M$ and $N$, respectively. What is the perimeter of $\triangle AMN$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that circle $O$ is the incircle of $\triangle ABC$, and tangent $MN$ intersects $AB$ and $AC$ at points $M$ and $N$, respectively,

$\therefore BF=BE,\ CF=CD,\ DN=NG,\ EM=GM,\ AD=AE.$

$\because$ the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is $20\text{ cm}$ and $BC=6\text{ cm}$,

$\therefore AE=AD=\frac{AB+AC-BC}{2}=\frac{20-BC-BC}{2}=\frac{20-12}{2}=4\text{ cm}.$

$\therefore$ the perimeter of $\triangle AMN$ is
$AM+MG+NG+AN=AM+ME+AN+ND=AE+AD=4+4=\boxed{8}\text{ cm}.$
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure is triangle ABC, A is on the right side, C is on the left side, B is above; circle O is located inside the triangle and is tangent to the three sides, and is the incircle of triangle ABC. There is also a tangent line MN tangent to circle O, M is on side AB, N is on side CA, and the point of tangency G is located between M and N.

Then reason: Let the points of tangency of the incircle with AB, AC, BC be E, D, F respectively, and the point of tangency of MN with the circle be G. From the same point drawing two tangent lines to a circle, the tangent segments are equal, so AE=AD, BE=BF, CD=CF, ME=MG, ND=NG.

It is known that the perimeter of triangle ABC is 20 cm, and BC=6 cm, so AB+AC=20-6=14 cm. Also because AB=AE+BE, AC=AD+CD, BC=BF+CF, and BE=BF, CD=CF, AE=AD, therefore AB+AC-BC=(AE+BE)+(AD+CD)-(BF+CF)=AE+AD=2AE. Thus AE=AD=(AB+AC-BC)/2=(20-2×6)/2=4 cm.

The perimeter of triangle AMN is AM+MN+AN. Because MN=MG+GN, and MG=ME, GN=ND, so AM+MN+AN=AM+ME+ND+AN=(AM+ME)+(AN+ND)=AE+AD=4+4=8 cm.

Final answer: 8 cm.
